decisions.reason: The source changes connector orientation on the main board only; it does not change the sensor board's placement or interboard-alignment requirements.
The source concerns main-board connectors and does not alter any power-board mechanical-layout constraint.
Changing the physical orientation and style of the main-board connectors does not change their count, destinations, types, or individual-connector architecture.
The source does not change panel-control coverage, wiring, GPIO mappings, or connection mode.
Connector orientation has no entailed effect on LED supply voltage, switching, or data-level handling.
The source does not change ESP32 pin-access coverage, breakout technology, or the board's reuse role.
Replacing L-shaped connectors with straight connectors does not alter any GPIO assignment.
The source does not change the sensor board's connector inventory, families, pitches, pinouts, or connector count.
The connector-orientation change does not affect monitored rails, monitor placement, current coverage, or monitor hardware.
The source refers to connectors on the main-board layout and does not change the power-board battery connector's orientation, placement, type, or pinout.
Connector orientation does not alter the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The source does not change I2C resistor values, population policy, purpose, or topology.
